description_sk: NOVA mini – trup rev. 2 + krk + hlava (variant B E2): animačný model mechanizmov J1 (otáčanie trupu), PAN (otáčanie hlavy), ZDVIH (vysunutie krku kľukou) a NÁKLON (kývanie hlavy).
units: glTF: metres, Y up, right-handed. Robot front = +Z, robot left = +X, up = +Y. Design (B) frame mm -> glTF: (x, y, z)_B -> (x, z, -y) / 1000.
how_to_pose: Choose the 4 independent drivers: j1 (deg), pan (deg), theta (deg, lift servo) or lift (mm), tilt (deg).

For every joint node: rotate -> node.rotation = quaternion(axis, radians(ratio * driver)), node.translation = rest_translation; translate -> node.rotation = identity, node.translation = rest_translation + axis * value / 1000 (value in mm).

Coupled nodes: pinion_J1 = +1.0 * j1 (relative to the torso; absolute 2 * j1), pan_pinion = -2.0 * pan, crank = theta, LIFT = 10 * (1 - cos(theta)) mm.  No other node is touched; every mesh node keeps its own (rest) transform.
Respect the limits: |j1| <= 150 (hard stop 153.4), |pan| <= 85 (hard stop 90), theta 0..180 (lift 0..20), -tilt_up_max(lift) <= tilt <= tilt_down_max(lift).

j1.sign_sk: kladný uhol = trup sa otočí proti smeru hodinových ručičiek pri pohľade zhora (predok ide k ľavému boku robota, +X)

pan.sign_sk: kladný uhol = hlava sa pozrie doľava (z pohľadu robota), proti smeru hodinových ručičiek zhora

theta.note: lift servo angle; firmware may stop at 3..177 (checks.py K6 lists that row) - the model allows 0..180
theta.sign_sk: 0 = čap kľuky dole (krk zasunutý), 90 = čap vpredu, 180 = čap hore (krk vysunutý o 20 mm)

tilt.sign_sk: kladný = hlava kýve dopredu dole (prikývnutie), záporný = hore

joints.axis_frame: parent node frame = model frame at rest (all joint nodes have identity rest rotation)
joints.pivot_note: node origin = point on the joint axis, model frame (glTF metres) at rest
joints.description_sk: J1 – otáčanie celého trupu okolo zvislej osi voči podstavcu
joints.drive_sk: Feetech STS3215 v trupe (hriadeľ dole) s pastorkom m1 z18, ktorý sa odvaľuje po pevnom centrálnom kolese m1 z18 podstavca; trup sa otočí o rovnaký uhol ako výstup serva voči trupu (prevod 1 : 1)

joints.axis_frame: parent node frame = model frame at rest (all joint nodes have identity rest rotation)
joints.pivot_note: node origin = point on the joint axis, model frame (glTF metres) at rest
joints.formula: angle = (z_sun / z_pinion) * j1 = +1.0 * j1 (relative to the torso; absolute 2 * j1)
joints.description_sk: pastorok J1 m1 z18 na hriadeli STS3215 – obieha s trupom a odvaľuje sa po centrálnom kolese

joints.axis_frame: parent node frame = model frame at rest (all joint nodes have identity rest rotation)
joints.pivot_note: node origin = point on the joint axis, model frame (glTF metres) at rest
joints.description_sk: pastorok pan m0,8 z18 na serve STS3032 (pevné v trupe) – točí kolesom z36 na šachte

joints.axis_frame: parent node frame = model frame at rest (all joint nodes have identity rest rotation)
joints.pivot_note: node origin = point on the joint axis, model frame (glTF metres) at rest
joints.description_sk: PAN – otáčanie hlavy: šachta, koleso z36, kapsa serva zdvihu, kľuka, pätka, ucho, krk, golier a hlava
joints.drive_sk: Feetech STS3032 (pevne v trupe, hriadeľ hore) s pastorkom m0,8 z18 -> koleso m0,8 z36 lepené pod šachtou; prevod 2 : 1 (servo sa otočí o -2 x pan); šachta beží v ložisku trupu (čap r 26,5 + PTFE) a na čape T_cap

joints.axis_frame: parent node frame = model frame at rest (all joint nodes have identity rest rotation)
joints.pivot_note: node origin = point on the joint axis, model frame (glTF metres) at rest
joints.description_sk: kľuka zdvihu – hliníkové rameno serva MG90S s čapom Ø2 na r 10
joints.drive_sk: MG90S v kapse na šachte; hriadeľ pozdĺž osi X v bode (y 23,2, z -24,2); theta 0 = čap dole (zdvih 0), 90 = čap vpredu (zdvih 10), 180 = čap hore (zdvih 20); oba krajné body sú úvrate kľuky

joints.axis_frame: parent node frame = model frame at rest (all joint nodes have identity rest rotation)
joints.pivot_note: node origin = point on the joint axis, model frame (glTF metres) at rest
joints.formula: offset = lift = 10 * (1 - cos(theta)) mm along the axis
joints.description_sk: ZDVIH – vysunutie krku 0–20 mm (pätka, ucho, DPS_krk, krk, hlava)
joints.drive_sk: čap kľuky sa posúva vo vodorovnej drážke nerezového ucha (2,2 x 12,7) a dvíha ucho s pätkou; krk je vedený v šachte na PTFE pásikoch, takže sa len posúva hore-dole

joints.axis_frame: parent node frame = model frame at rest (all joint nodes have identity rest rotation)
joints.pivot_note: node origin = point on the joint axis, model frame (glTF metres) at rest
joints.formula: angle = tilt (+ = nod down / front down); tilt_down_max = min(40, 4 + 1.9 * lift); tilt_up_max = 10 (lift < 7.5), 30 (7.5 <= lift < 12.5), 40 (lift >= 12.5)
joints.description_sk: NÁKLON – kývanie hlavy na závese (os X cez y 0, z -3,5 + zdvih)
joints.drive_sk: MG90S v hornej časti krku, hriadeľ na osi závesu; páka zaklinená v uchu hlavy -X, na strane +X ložisko MR85 na dutom čape

couplings.J1_gears: pastorok_J1 m1 z18 (na STS3215 v trupe) x centrálne koleso Z_koleso_J1 m1 z18 (pevné v podstavci), osová vzdialenosť 18,00: pastorok voči trupu = +1,0 x j1 (planétový prevod so stojacim centrálnym kolesom), absolútne 2 x j1
couplings.PAN_gears: pastorok_pan m0,8 z18 (na STS3032 pevnom v trupe) x koleso_pan m0,8 z36 (na šachte), osová vzdialenosť 21,600: pastorok = -2,0 x pan
couplings.lift_crank: kľuka r 10,00 na MG90S; čap Ø2 v drážke ucha 2,2 x 12,7 (stred drážky y 12,7..23,2 pri z -34,2 + zdvih); zdvih = 10 (1 - cos theta); čap sa v drážke posúva dopredu a späť (y = 23,2 - 10 sin theta)
couplings.tilt_limits: náklon dole je pri zasunutom krku obmedzený (4 deg pri zdvihu 0) – hlava by narazila do goliera; plný rozsah ±40 až pri zdvihu >= 18,95 (dole) a >= 12,5 (hore)

hierarchy: root -> base_static (podstavec); root -> J1 -> {statické diely trupu, pinion_J1 -> pastorok_J1, pan_pinion -> pastorok_pan, PAN -> {šachta, koleso z36, kapsa serva zdvihu + MG90S, kotúč goliera, crank -> {rameno_zdvih, cap_kluky, skr_ramena}, LIFT -> {L_pata, L_ucho, DPS_krk, krk, servo náklonu, TILT -> diely hlavy}}}

omitted_sk.ffc_par, ffc_A/B_krk, ffc_A/B_nosic: pásiky FFC – tvar slučky sa mení s pan aj zdvihom (nie je to tuhé teleso)
omitted_sk.pigtail_zdvih: pigtail serva zdvihu – ohybná slučka, tvar sa mení so zdvihom
omitted_sk.lozisko_6805: nahradené dvoma krúžkami (vnútorný stojí s podstavcom, vonkajší sa otáča s J1) – len vizualizácia

T4/checks.py K3 (J1 pinion rolled 2 x phi, pan pinion -2 x pan)
B/build.py (pose / tf: hinge axis X at AXZ, + tilt = nod down)
viewers_sk: GLB sa dá otvoriť napr. v Blenderi (File > Import > glTF 2.0; klipy sú v NLA / Action editore), vo Windows 3D Viewer alebo v ľubovoľnom webovom prehliadači glTF (súbor sa len pretiahne do okna; animácie 1–5 sa vyberú v zozname animácií). Kryty sa dajú skryť podľa skupiny v extras (group = shell).
